Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

synthcheck 0.0.0.9000

  • New: run_synthcheck_app() opens a Shiny app that generates synthetic respondents with several language models and benchmarks them in five tabs: Instrument, Personas, Models (API keys, temperature, attempts, a progress bar with the time left), Compare (the benchmark with a plain-language summary per model) and Export. API keys stay in memory for the session. The Instrument and Personas tabs offer CSV templates to fill in.

  • New: sc_instrument(), sc_personas(), sc_persona_grid(), sc_model() and sc_prompt() define what synthetic respondents take and who they are, and generate_synthetic() asks Anthropic, OpenAI or local Ollama models (through ellmer) to answer, one respondent per call.

  • New: write_synthetic() and read_synthetic() save and load generated data as CSV, JSON, RDS or Excel, and as_synthetic_list() turns a long table into the input of authenticity_benchmark().

  • New: summarise_benchmark() describes each model’s benchmark result in a few plain sentences.

  • New: behaviour_features() gives eight behaviour features per respondent (variability, extreme and midpoint answers, acquiescence, key inconsistency, even-odd consistency, Mahalanobis distance and person fit lz), synthetic_behaviour() turns them into the Behaviour index, and gg_behaviour() draws the behaviour strip.

  • New: authenticity_benchmark() builds the synthetic authenticity benchmark: Overlap, Structure and Behaviour for every model, each anchored between shuffled real columns (0) and a second sample of real people (100), with the weakest column as the default score. gg_benchmark() draws it on a scale from red (-100 or less) through pale (0) to blue (100), so values below the shuffled baseline stay readable.

  • New: flag_careless() flags careless real respondents, and clean_real = TRUE compares against the remaining ones.

  • Data: hexaco_llm now holds six models (89,597 synthetic respondents). Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-4.1 mini were added.

  • First version of the package. synthetic_coverage(), blend_llms() and gg_coverage() (Overlap, Structure and the best blend of models, drawn as a coverage strip) are ported from mirtverse, with theme_synthcheck().

  • Data: hexaco_real (17,874 real respondents from Canada, Great Britain and the United States), hexaco_llm (59,611 synthetic respondents from four language models) and hexaco_items for the 240 IPIP-HEXACO items, also from mirtverse.
